types.note: A BOARD's identity fact, keyed canvas:<board> (ADR-0046) — the node board-membership edges point at (placements project `<fact> onBoard canvas:<board>`). Value: {board, title?}.

A board PLACEMENT (ADR-0046): the edge-with-properties that puts a fact on a board. Keyed _canvas/<board>/<factKey>; the key-encoded rule projects `<factKey> onBoard canvas:<board>` into the Reference graph (the membership edge — ADR-0016: an edge with attributes is a fact whose key encodes its endpoints, exactly like lit's doc-order). Geometry (x/y/width/height/scale/rotation/zIndex…) are THIS fact's value — properties of the membership, never of the placed fact. The placed fact is unchanged by being placed (no-graduation).
